visual.general_description: Two grayscale radiographs labelled a and b, a chest film and an abdominal film, showing several tubes and cannulae with white, gray and black arrows and rows of small white triangles.
visual.detailed_description: Two portrait-oriented X-ray images side by side separated by a white gutter. Panel a (left) is a chest radiograph with the letter "a" printed in white at upper left and the text "L" over "SUP" at upper right. Several thin tube lines run down through the upper chest alongside the spine. A white arrow points to a tube line in the upper mediastinal region and a gray arrow points to a tube line at mid chest. A row of six small white triangles runs down along a long tube line. Panel b (right) is an abdominal radiograph with the letter "b" printed in white at upper left and "L" at lower right. A black arrow points to a tube lying over the pelvic region on the image left, and four small white triangles run along the tube at the top of the panel. No numbers, dates or patient text are printed.

panels.general_description: Chest radiograph with several tubes crossing the chest, white and gray arrows on cannula tips and a row of small white triangles on a drainage cannula.
panels.detailed_description: Grayscale chest film with the printed letter "a", and "L" over "SUP" at the upper right. Multiple fine tube lines descend through the neck and upper chest. A white arrow marks one tube tip in the upper mediastinum, a gray arrow marks another tube near mid chest, and six small white triangles run in a vertical row along a long tube beside the spine. A looped line is visible to the right of the spine and a curved line crosses the lower chest. The lung fields appear uniformly hazy with the ribs faintly seen through them.

visual.general_description: One composite grayscale figure combining a treatment timeline, a chart of ECMO flow, cardiac output and minute volume, and a chart of oxygen measurements and settings over the hour axis.
visual.detailed_description: Top: a timeline of labelled block arrows (V-A ECMO, V-AV ECMO, V-V ECMO, Adjusted the drainage cannula, TEE) above bars labelled Rocuronium and Lung rest setting. Middle: a chart with left axis ECMO flow CCO [L/min], right axis MV [L/min], shaded V-A and V-V areas and CCO(LiDCO), CCO(PAC) and MV lines. Bottom: a chart with PO2 [mmHg], FO2 and S_PreO2 [%] axes and markers and lines labelled P_PostO2, PaO2, P_PAO2, S_PreO2, F_DO2 and F_IO2. All three share an hour axis labelled [h]. No numeric labels are printed on the data.

panels.general_description: Composite clinical course figure with a labelled treatment timeline on top, an upper chart of ECMO flow, continuous cardiac output and minute volume over hours, and a lower chart of oxygen partial pressures, delivered and inspired oxygen fractions and pre-membrane saturation over hours.
panels.detailed_description: A grayscale figure with a shared hour axis (printed ticks 0, 1, 5, 10 and every 5 hours to 60). Across the top, block arrows are labelled "V-A ECMO", "V-AV ECMO", "V-V ECMO", "Adjusted the drainage cannula" and "TEE". Below the arrows a light gray bar is labelled "Rocuronium" and a second, longer light gray bar is labelled "Lung rest setting (PCV, PEEP 5cmH2O, PIP 10cmH2O, RR 5/min)". The upper chart has a left axis "ECMO flow CCO [L/min]" with ticks 0, 2, 4 and 6 and a right axis "MV [L/min]" with ticks 0, 1, 2 and 3. A dark gray shaded area labelled "V-A" appears only in the earlier part of the time axis, while a lighter gray area labelled "V-V" extends across the whole axis. Two continuous cardiac output lines are labelled "CCO(LiDCO)" (thin double outline) and "CCO(PAC)" (thick black); both fluctuate, and the thick line has a gap. A dotted line labelled "MV" stays low and drifts upward with fluctuations. The lower chart has a left axis "PO2 [mmHg]" with ticks 0, 50, 100, 200, 300, 400 and 500, a right axis "FO2" with ticks 0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8 and 1.0, and a further right axis "S_PreO2 [%]" with printed ticks 0, 60, 80 and 100. Open diamonds are labelled "P_PostO2", filled black dots "PaO2", open circles "P_PAO2", a thin double-outline fluctuating line "S_PreO2", a thick stepped black line "F_DO2" with plateaus and two brief upward spikes, and a dotted horizontal line "F_IO2". No data labels are printed on the points.
